description: Final one-shot release-candidate holdout across RAG hallucination analysis, medical QA, and multimodal long-document understanding.
freeze_policy: All facts must pass page-scoped PDF parser preflight before freezing. After freezing, any implementation, prompt, case, gold, or retrieval-configuration change motivated by H15 reclassifies the set as development-regression; no immediate H16 replacement is allowed.
stop_rule: Run the frozen gate sequence once. On pass, end this development cycle. On failure, record the boundary and move it to backlog without repairing against H15; reopen shared fixes only when the same failure appears in at least two unrelated papers.
